$comment: Single source of the .env settings. configure.bat prompts for these and writes .env; it also regenerates .env.example from them. To add a setting: add an entry here (and to app/backend/app/config.py if the backend reads it). tests/test_settings_schema.py keeps the two in sync. Types: host, port, int, number, relpath, string, secret (prompted hidden, never written to .env.example).

settings.name: ARCHEION_HOST
settings.description: Address the backend listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless other machines must reach it.

settings.name: ARCHEION_PORT
settings.description: Backend port (workspace AI / Agent APIs range, see ../CLAUDE.md).

settings.name: ARCHEION_DB_PATH
settings.description: The backend's SQLite database (admin credential hash, sessions, feedback), relative to the repo root.

settings.name: ARCHEION_WORKSPACE_ROOT
settings.description: The folder holding all your projects, relative to the repo root. Registered project paths must stay inside it, and projects scan looks for new ones there.

settings.name: ARCHEION_FRONTEND_PORT
settings.description: Frontend dev server port (Vite). It proxies /api to the backend.

settings.name: ARCHEION_SESSION_IDLE_HOURS
settings.description: Log out after this many hours without activity.

settings.name: ARCHEION_SESSION_MAX_DAYS
settings.description: Log out this many days after login at the latest.
